identification: Long narrow pale live-edge rough-sawn slab (about 2.2 m by 20 cm), one of a run of four chalked 1128 to 1131; 1129 to 1131 look cut from the same log. Pale straw colour with knots and some dark staining is consistent with Huon pine but not confirmed from one photo; could be celery top pine or similar. Value is low either way.

viewing_check: Check end grain and smell: Huon pine has a strong sweet resinous smell, very fine tight growth rings, pale yellow to honey colour. Photograph the end grain and measure length, width and thickness. Look for splits or rot. Celery top or other pine will lack the scent and have wider rings.
